parameters.name: Aircraft.Wing.ASPECT_RATIO
parameters.description: Wing aspect ratio (span^2 / area). Higher values reduce induced drag but increase structural weight. Advisory bounds [7.0, 17.0] cover modern transport aircraft including high-AR designs like the DLR-F25 (AR=15.6). RELIABILITY NOTE: the default aircraft baseline (aircraft_for_bench_FwFm.csv, A320-class) has its FLOPS aero buildup and engine deck tabulated for AR ~= 9-12. Setting AR > ~12 with this baseline causes the climb-phase Newton solver to evaluate residuals out of the table range and return inf/NaN (AVIARY_SETUP_ERROR). For reliable trajectory solves on the default aircraft, keep AR in reliable_range [9.0, 11.5]. For genuine F25-class fidelity, a custom aircraft CSV with calibrated high-AR aero/engine tables is required (not currently shipped).

parameters.name: Aircraft.Wing.AREA
parameters.description: Wing reference (planform) area. Larger wings produce more lift but more drag and weight.

parameters.name: Aircraft.Wing.SPAN
parameters.description: Wing tip-to-tip span. Derived: span = sqrt(AR * area). Read-only — set ASPECT_RATIO and/or AREA instead.

parameters.name: Aircraft.Wing.SWEEP
parameters.description: Quarter-chord sweep angle. Higher sweep delays drag rise at transonic speeds.

parameters.name: Aircraft.Wing.TAPER_RATIO
parameters.description: Ratio of tip chord to root chord. Lower values improve span loading efficiency.

parameters.name: Aircraft.Wing.THICKNESS_TO_CHORD
parameters.description: Wing mean thickness / chord (chord-weighted). FLOPS uses it for the design Mach (compressibility drag), the wing form factor and the wing fuel capacity.

parameters.name: Aircraft.Fuselage.LENGTH
parameters.description: Overall fuselage length. Affects wetted area, friction drag, and cabin capacity.

parameters.name: Aircraft.Fuselage.MAX_HEIGHT
parameters.description: Maximum fuselage cross-section height.

parameters.name: Aircraft.Fuselage.MAX_WIDTH
parameters.description: Maximum fuselage cross-section width.

parameters.name: Aircraft.Engine.SCALED_SLS_THRUST
parameters.default_source: bench aircraft file (aircraft:engine:scaled_sls_thrust); with an engine deck, the deck SLS thrust x SCALE_FACTOR
parameters.description: Scaled sea-level static thrust per engine. Computed as SCALE_FACTOR * reference_sls_thrust (28928.1 lbf). Read-only — modify via SCALE_FACTOR.

parameters.name: Aircraft.Engine.SCALE_FACTOR
parameters.description: Engine scale factor relative to the reference engine. Scales thrust, mass, and fuel flow.

parameters.name: Mission.Design.LIFT_COEFFICIENT
parameters.default_source: computed by Aviary from aspect ratio, quarter-chord sweep and camber (FLOPS design-CL rule, aerodynamics/flops_based/design.py); 0.5674 for the bench wing. Follows the wing unless set
parameters.description: Design lift coefficient of Aviary's FLOPS drag polar. It is NOT a trim target: the mission flies whatever lift coefficient its weight needs at each point, and nothing sizes the wing or trims to this value. Aviary computes it from the wing (aspect ratio, sweep, camber) and uses it as the reference point of the lift-dependent pressure-drag table, which is looked up at (flown CL - this value) and (flown Mach - design Mach). Setting it replaces Aviary's computed value (an override; the design Mach is still computed from Aviary's own design CL), so it moves the drag polar, and with it the drag and fuel, at every point of the mission. run_simulation reports the value flown and Aviary's computed value under overridden_outputs.

parameters.name: Aircraft.Design.SUBSONIC_DRAG_COEFF_FACTOR
parameters.description: Multiplies Aviary's whole FLOPS drag coefficient (friction, form, lift-dependent pressure, induced and compressibility drag, after the bench file's own zero-lift and lift-dependent factors) at every subsonic point of the mission (aerodynamics/flops_based/drag.py: CD = CD_prescaled x this factor). It is one number for the whole polar, not a separate scale on zero-lift or induced drag.

parameters.name: Aircraft.Wing.MASS_SCALER
parameters.description: Multiplicative scale on Aviary's FLOPS structural wing mass (Aircraft.Wing.MASS = bending material + shear control + misc; excludes high-lift devices and surface controls). Phase K-A sets this from mass-mcp's externally computed wing mass — verified to move fuel_burn_kg in a direct sensitivity sweep (0.5 → 9.7t, 1.5 → 10.4t fuel).

parameters.name: Aircraft.Wing.MASS
parameters.default_source: computed by Aviary (FLOPS wing mass) unless set
parameters.description: Structural wing mass flown, set directly (Avion B240): replaces Aviary's FLOPS wing estimate, so the mission carries exactly this wing. The framework sets it from mass-mcp's wing mass. Use instead of MASS_SCALER, which multiplies Aviary's own estimate for the current geometry and weight and so cannot reproduce a given mass (measured: scaler 1.50 flew 12,400 kg where mass-mcp said 8,995 kg).

parameters.name: Aircraft.HorizontalTail.AREA
parameters.description: Horizontal tail: Planform (reference) area. Drives the tail's wetted area (friction drag) and its FLOPS mass.

parameters.name: Aircraft.HorizontalTail.ASPECT_RATIO
parameters.description: Horizontal tail: Aspect ratio (span^2 / area). FLOPS uses it for the tail's characteristic length (Reynolds number of its friction drag).

parameters.name: Aircraft.HorizontalTail.TAPER_RATIO
parameters.description: Horizontal tail: Tip chord / root chord. FLOPS uses it in the tail's wetted area and mass.

parameters.name: Aircraft.HorizontalTail.THICKNESS_TO_CHORD
parameters.description: Horizontal tail: Mean thickness / chord. FLOPS uses it in the tail's wetted area, form factor and in surface-control and hydraulics mass.

parameters.name: Aircraft.VerticalTail.AREA
parameters.description: Vertical tail: Planform (reference) area of one vertical tail. Drives its wetted area (friction drag) and its FLOPS mass, surface-control and hydraulics mass.

parameters.name: Aircraft.VerticalTail.ASPECT_RATIO
parameters.description: Vertical tail: Aspect ratio (height^2 / area). FLOPS uses it for the tail's characteristic length.

parameters.name: Aircraft.VerticalTail.TAPER_RATIO
parameters.description: Vertical tail: Tip chord / root chord. FLOPS uses it in the tail's wetted area and mass.

parameters.name: Aircraft.VerticalTail.THICKNESS_TO_CHORD
parameters.description: Vertical tail: Mean thickness / chord. FLOPS uses it in the tail's wetted area and form factor.

Setting it replaces Aviary's computed value (an override; the design Mach is still computed from Aviary's own design CL), so it moves the drag polar, and with it the drag and fuel, at every point of the mission. run_simulation reports the value flown and Aviary's computed value under overridden_outputs.

parameters.name: Aircraft.Design.SUBSONIC_DRAG_COEFF_FACTOR
parameters.description: Multiplies Aviary's whole FLOPS drag coefficient (friction, form, lift-dependent pressure, induced and compressibility drag, after the bench file's own zero-lift and lift-dependent factors) at every subsonic point of the mission (aerodynamics/flops_based/drag.py: CD = CD_prescaled x this factor). It is one number for the whole polar, not a separate scale on zero-lift or induced drag.

parameters.name: Aircraft.Wing.MASS_SCALER
parameters.description: Multiplicative scale on Aviary's FLOPS structural wing mass (Aircraft.Wing.MASS = bending material + shear control + misc; excludes high-lift devices and surface controls). Phase K-A sets this from mass-mcp's externally computed wing mass — verified to move fuel_burn_kg in a direct sensitivity sweep (0.5 → 9.7t, 1.5 → 10.4t fuel).

parameters.name: Aircraft.Wing.MASS
parameters.default_source: computed by Aviary (FLOPS wing mass) unless set
parameters.description: Structural wing mass flown, set directly (Avion B240): replaces Aviary's FLOPS wing estimate, so the mission carries exactly this wing. The framework sets it from mass-mcp's wing mass. Use instead of MASS_SCALER, which multiplies Aviary's own estimate for the current geometry and weight and so cannot reproduce a given mass (measured: scaler 1.50 flew 12,400 kg where mass-mcp said 8,995 kg).

parameters.name: Aircraft.HorizontalTail.AREA
parameters.description: Horizontal tail: Planform (reference) area. Drives the tail's wetted area (friction drag) and its FLOPS mass.

parameters.name: Aircraft.HorizontalTail.ASPECT_RATIO
parameters.description: Horizontal tail: Aspect ratio (span^2 / area). FLOPS uses it for the tail's characteristic length (Reynolds number of its friction drag).

parameters.name: Aircraft.HorizontalTail.TAPER_RATIO
parameters.description: Horizontal tail: Tip chord / root chord. FLOPS uses it in the tail's wetted area and mass.

parameters.name: Aircraft.HorizontalTail.THICKNESS_TO_CHORD
parameters.description: Horizontal tail: Mean thickness / chord. FLOPS uses it in the tail's wetted area, form factor and in surface-control and hydraulics mass.

parameters.name: Aircraft.VerticalTail.AREA
parameters.description: Vertical tail: Planform (reference) area of one vertical tail. Drives its wetted area (friction drag) and its FLOPS mass, surface-control and hydraulics mass.

parameters.name: Aircraft.VerticalTail.ASPECT_RATIO
parameters.description: Vertical tail: Aspect ratio (height^2 / area). FLOPS uses it for the tail's characteristic length.

parameters.name: Aircraft.VerticalTail.TAPER_RATIO
parameters.description: Vertical tail: Tip chord / root chord. FLOPS uses it in the tail's wetted area and mass.

parameters.name: Aircraft.VerticalTail.THICKNESS_TO_CHORD
parameters.description: Vertical tail: Mean thickness / chord. FLOPS uses it in the tail's wetted area and form factor.
